subject: Municipal Building Maintenance and Library Repairs
overview: The City Council held its organizational meeting, electing leadership before addressing critical infrastructure failures at the public library and business access issues caused by ongoing bridge construction.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: The Council elected Frederick N. Dello Russo as President, Breanna Lungo-Koehn as Vice President, and Lawrence Lepore as City Messenger for the 2016-2017 term.

items.title: Adoption of Rules and Transfer of Papers
items.summary: Approved the adoption of standing committee rules and the transfer of all pending business from the 2015 Council to the 2016 session.

items.title: Medford Public Library Maintenance and Building Assessment
items.summary: Approved a resolution to repair the leaking library roof and conduct a comprehensive review of all municipal building maintenance needs, including a potential five-year capital plan. Discussion highlighted ruined books, the need for a dedicated buildings and grounds manager, and long-term modernization goals for the facility.

items.title: Cradock Bridge Construction Impact
items.summary: Referred a request for temporary parking and improved business access on Main Street during the Cradock Bridge construction to the administration and the transportation subcommittee. Local business owners reported that Jersey barriers and poor signage were deterring customers and making the area dangerous for pedestrians.

items.title: License Approvals and Routine Resolutions
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Route 28 Smoke Shop and requested a public update from the Department of Public Works regarding the Christmas tree pickup schedule.

items.title: Petitions Regarding the Administration and Council Leadership
items.summary: Upheld a ruling that a petition regarding transition team members was out of order, and the Council voted to indefinitely postpone a citizen petition for a no-confidence vote against the Council President.

items.title: Proposed Municipal Law Amendments
items.summary: Discussed a 50-page proposal from the Governor regarding amendments to municipal laws and agreed to review the document in a future Committee of the Whole meeting.
